WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(s.s_store_id, r.s_store_id) AS s_store_id,
         COALESCE(s.sales, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS sales,
         COALESCE(s.profit, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit,
         COALESCE(r.returns, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS returns,
         COALESCE(r.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_filter ON ss_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s_store_id
  ) s
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_filter ON sr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON sr_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s_store_id
  ) r ON s.s_store_id = r.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(s.cp_catalog_page_id, r.cp_catalog_page_id) AS cp_catalog_page_id,
         COALESCE(s.sales, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS sales,
         COALESCE(s.profit, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit,
         COALESCE(r.returns, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS returns,
         COALESCE(r.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_filter ON cs_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
  ) s
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS returns,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN date_filter ON cr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page ON cr_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
  ) r ON s.cp_catalog_page_id = r.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(s.web_site_id, r.web_site_id) AS web_site_id,
         COALESCE(s.sales, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS sales,
         COALESCE(s.profit, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit,
         COALESCE(r.returns, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS returns,
         COALESCE(r.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_filter ON ws_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY web_site_id
  ) s
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number
    JOIN date_filter ON wr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY web_site_id
  ) r ON s.web_site_id = r.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || s_store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
